proposal.reason: Primary change is communicator-level configuration controls: new config fields are parsed/validated/defaulted, overridden from env, stored on the communicator, and synchronized across ranks (including accepting nvlinkCentricSched without enabling scheduling behavior). Add enqueue because graphUsageMode now changes strong-stream acquire/release and capture handling plus P2P plan batching behavior/erroring in scheduling-to-plan. Add device-topology because P2P channel-per-peer computation and maxP2pPeers-driven channel tuning/capping are implemented in topology path/channel calculation logic.
